study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
cohort: Women with preterm preeclampsia participating in the PHOENIX trial.
finding: Planned delivery was associated with higher rates of neonatal unit admission for prematurity compared to expectant management, but similar lengths of neonatal unit stay and neonatal morbidity across both groups, with earlier gestation, severe preeclampsia, and small-for-gestational age increasing neonatal unit admission.
mod_finding: Among women who started induction of labour, 63% delivered vaginally, with 56% delivering vaginally at 34 weeks' gestation.
gest_age: Late preterm (specifically mentioning 34 weeks' gestation and earlier gestation at delivery)
